about: Every frame of the splash board as its own PNG at native size: <option>_<scene>_z<zoom>_<phase>.png are 1:1 crops of the game's frames (640 x 340 at zoom 1, 560 x 280 at zoom 0.35; the same crop for every option), context_* whole 1280 x 720 frames, palette_strip.png the colours. S0 is today.

frames.title: S0 - river - zoom 1 - peak
frames.caption: Today: ink rings (units, bombs, shells) and G3's pale ring (tank rounds). RIVER: left to right on the water a tank round, a cruiser shell, a bomb; the same three rounds on the field across the bank; two tanks for size, zoom 1, at its peak, 0.35 s after it lands. 1:1 crop of the game's frame.

frames.title: The palette beside the water
frames.caption: Paper, ink, the flash step, the shadow tint and the water, then the nine spray roles laid over the water, then the wash and the ring of S3. One palette: lightness is a ramp off the paper, no new hue.
